insert.column: SELECT DATE(ph.created_date) AS provisioning_as_of_date, ph.executed_at AS run_executed_at, created_user.username AS run_by, o.name AS office_name, COALESCE(def.category_code, pc.category_code, '-') AS category_code, COALESCE(def.category_name, CASE WHEN e.classification_type = 'WRITTEN_OFF_PORTFOLIO' THEN 'Written-Off Portfolio' ELSE pc.category_name END, e.classification_type) AS category_label, pcv.version_no AS criteria_version_no, pc.criteria_name, e.currency_code, SUM(e.reseve_amount) AS total_reserved_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM m_provisioning_history ph JOIN m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry e ON e.history_id = ph.id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = e.office_id LEFT JOIN m_provisioning_criteria pc ON pc.id = e.criteria_id LEFT JOIN m_provisioning_criteria_version pcv ON pcv.id = e.criteria_version_id LEFT JOIN m_provisioning_criteria_definition def ON def.id = e.criteria_definition_id LEFT JOIN m_provision_category pc ON pc.id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN m_appuser created_user ON created_user.id = ph.createdby_id WHERE ph.id = ${provisioningEntryId} AND o.id = ${officeId} GROUP BY provisioning_as_of_date, run_executed_at, run_by, office_name, category_code, category_label, criteria_version_no, pc.criteria_name, e.currency_code ORDER BY office_name, category_code

column.name: description
column.value: Provisioning run totals by category using stored definition snapshots (supports N buckets and Written-Off Portfolio).

changeSet.sql: UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = 'SELECT DATE(ph.created_date) AS provisioning_as_of_date, ph.executed_at AS run_executed_at, created_user.username AS run_by, o.name AS office_name, COALESCE(def.category_code, pc.category_code, ''-'') AS category_code, COALESCE(def.category_name, CASE WHEN e.classification_type = ''WRITTEN_OFF_PORTFOLIO'' THEN ''Written-Off Portfolio'' ELSE pc.category_name END, e.classification_type) AS category_label, pcv.version_no AS criteria_version_no, pc.criteria_name, e.currency_code, SUM(e.reseve_amount) AS total_reserved_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM m_provisioning_history ph JOIN m_loanproduct_provisioning_entry e ON e.history_id = ph.id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = e.office_id LEFT JOIN m_provisioning_criteria pc ON pc.id = e.criteria_id LEFT JOIN m_provisioning_criteria_version pcv ON pcv.id = e.criteria_version_id LEFT JOIN m_provisioning_criteria_definition def ON def.id = e.criteria_definition_id LEFT JOIN m_provision_category pc ON pc.id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN m_appuser created_user ON created_user.id = ph.createdby_id WHERE ph.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM m_provisioning_history) AND o.id = ${officeId} GROUP BY provisioning_as_of_date, run_executed_at, run_by, office_name, category_code, category_label, criteria_version_no, pc.criteria_name, e.currency_code ORDER BY office_name, category_code', description = 'Latest provisioning run: reserved amounts by category snapshot and criteria version (office scope).' WHERE report_name = 'Provisioning By Category (Latest Run)';
